# 2026 Strix global SKUs are not Belgian SKUs

Both supplied exports contain official ASUS global specifications. Each 5080 configuration lists 290HX Plus, RTX 5080 at 175W, 64GB (2x32GB), 2TB, matte 240Hz Mini-LED, G-SYNC, Advanced Optimus, two M.2 slots, two Thunderbolt 5 ports, three USB-A, 2.5GbE, 90Wh and a 380W adapter.

The exports contain no price, stock, keyboard layout, country or Belgian support entitlement. Web indexing identifies their source as the **ROG Global** specification page. On 13 August 2026 the equivalent `be-nl` 2026 Strix G16 product/specification route returned ASUS's `pagina niet gevonden`. ASUS Belgium's current RTX 5080 catalog showed 2026 SCAR 18 and Zephyrus G16, but no 2026 Strix G16; the listed 16-inch Strix/SCAR transactions remained 2025 models.

Conclusion: these are valid worldwide reference configurations and exceptionally good requirement matches, but not proof of a Belgian purchasable configuration.

- https://rog.asus.com/laptops/rog-strix/rog-strix-g16-2026/spec/?config=90NR0LG2-M00HS0
- https://www.asus.com/be-nl/store/laptops/
- https://www.asus.com/be-nl/laptops/for-gaming/all-series/filter?Spec=368115
